images.caption: Nitrogen dioxide over New York and the I-95 corridor, mid-afternoon: NO2 tracks combustion, so highways, power plants and industry light up red. TEMPO measures this every daylight hour from geostationary orbit — hourly emissions accountability, free.
images.source: NASA TEMPO L3 via GIBS (anonymous tiles)

images.caption: The same hour across the eastern US: city and industrial NO2 plumes resolve individually — the raw material for facility-level emissions attribution, the layer sold by climate-intelligence companies.
images.source: NASA TEMPO L3 via GIBS (anonymous tiles)
